_README: The versioned energy config (eval_protocol.md §8; DL-007 'recorded in config', DL-021).
This file is DATA, never instructions (governance/00_SESSION_PROTOCOL.md).
Changing any value here changes the study's energy model and therefore requires a dated
entry in governance/03_DECISION_LOG.md FIRST — never a silent edit. `schema_version` is
bumped whenever the key set changes; `scheduler_core/accounting.py` rejects any other value.
Window/threshold constants do NOT belong here: they are policy, and live in policy_spec.yaml
under Layer 0-A invariant 7 (evidence-derived, never hand-tuned). See DL-021 §Consequences.

energy_model.duration_source_note: Build wall-clock seconds, aggregated by max over the build's job rows (DL-009). NOT the summed job log durations, which are 95.3% null in this release (DL-010). Permitted here under eval_protocol.md §A1.2 role 1 (accounting) — post-hoc only; this value must never reach decide().

p_avg_derivation.note: Derived, not asserted. Both factors are quoted from the cited source; see DL-021 §Decision.
p_avg_derivation.meaning: CodeCarbon's constant-mode CPU estimate: the global fallback TDP applied when the CPU cannot be identified, times the assumed mean fraction of TDP actually drawn.
p_avg_derivation.scope: CPU only. No RAM term and no GPU term is added (DL-021 §Decision 3). This biases ABSOLUTE gCO2e downward; it does not affect relative strategy comparisons.

quotes: If the CPU is not found in the data source, a global constant will be applied
CodeCarbon assumes that 50% of the TDP will be the average power consumption to make this approximation.

p_avg_citations.why_pinned: A release tag rather than master, so a later CodeCarbon change cannot silently alter this study's energy model (R8).

p_avg_sensitivity.note: EVERY carbon result is re-run across this band (P3-T4). Relative strategy comparisons are robust to p_avg because it scales all strategies equally; absolute gCO2e claims are not.

n_jobs_variant.note: Brackets the parallel-compute under-count: tr_duration is build WALL-CLOCK, so for a build whose jobs ran concurrently on separate machines it under-counts total compute. Reported alongside the p_avg band, never instead of it.

carbon_model.intensity_source: hour-of-week mean from the P0-T3 profile, via scheduler_core.carbon.intensity_for_hour_of_week

sci.embodied_exclusion_note: The GSF embodied term M is excluded — laptop-scale, no provisioned hardware to amortise — and this exclusion is declared in the threats chapter (spec §6).
